title: Record that a prefix-walk return has even length
body:
## Summary
- A one-bit prefix step flips Hamming-weight parity, so every contiguous zero-XOR block has even length. The check covers every state and every label at width 7.
- A repeated label leaves the endpoint fixed and the pairwise-XOR set monotone. A fresh midpoint raises the revisit count by 1, and a repeated midpoint raises it by 2.
- Partial, no new kappa. This does not census words or claim f(7).
